subject: Follow-up: deployment mode selection & migration plan — Nova Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@novahealth.com>
Cc: John Lee <john.lee@novahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: deployment mode selection & migration plan — Nova Health

Hi Samira / John —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we can align on the right deployment mode for Nova Health (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC / on-prem):

Key points from call:
- Current stack: mix of custom API integration + legacy GPU cluster for research workloads.
- Primary goals: predictable latency (P95 < 300ms), strong data isolation for PHI, and lower unit cost vs current self-hosted setup.
- Traffic profile: expected 2000 requests/day initially with spikes up to 10k/day during monthly batch jobs.
- Security requirements: HIPAA controls, customer-managed KMS, audit logging for data access.

Our initial recommendation:
- Short term: Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU capacity) for predictable throughput and private networking to meet latency and PHI requirements.
- Medium term: Evaluate Private VPC deployment if Nova requires on-prem or stricter network isolation; we can run a pilot in VPC to validate.
- Migration path: start with a staged migration from current LLM API (3rd party) to Redwood Hosted for non-PHI endpoints while we provision Dedicated for PHI traffic, then cutover training/inference workloads to the Dedicated pool.

Open items / asks:
1) Can you share the compliance questionnaire answers (SOC2 / HIPAA) you flagged as priorities?
2) Any blocking procurement timelines or custom contract terms?
3) Do you have preferred encryption/KMS provider for the Private option (AWS KMS, HashiCorp Vault, etc.)?

I've attached a short decision matrix and a draft migration plan to help scope timelines and costs. Happy to run through this with your engineering and security teams — propose 30–45 min next week to walk the plan.

Attachments: migration_mode_decision_matrix.xlsx, migration_plan_draft.pdf

Thanks —
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0128

Marissa —

Thanks for the thorough recap. This matches our notes. A few clarifications from our side:
- We currently process PHI only in a subset of endpoints (clinical summarization). Those need to be isolated — dedicated tenancy or VPC preferred.
- Our procurement window is tight: we need pricing and template terms by end of month to get onto next quarter budget.
- KMS: we prefer AWS KMS (we're majority on AWS). For on-prem, the security team prefers an HSM-backed key store.

Next steps: please send a short cost estimate for Dedicated vs Private (pilot) and a proposed timeline for a two-phase migration. Also confirm what data residency guarantees Redwood provides in Dedicated (we are US-only today).

Samira

Subject: Draft: Dedicated vs Private pilot estimate + migration timeline

Hi all —

Per our internal work (attached), please find a short estimate and proposed two-phase migration timeline:

Summary (high-level):
- Option A — Dedicated (recommended short term): 3x A100-equivalent GPUs reserved, monthly committed price $42k, burst pool available up to +30% at on-demand rates. Meets P95 latency target for current traffic and supports PHI isolation with private tenancy.
- Option B — Private VPC pilot (medium term): 6–8 week pilot, one-week cutover window for PHI endpoints, additional engineering integration ~2 FTE-weeks. Pilot pricing: one-time onboarding fee $12k + pilot monthly $18k.

Proposed timeline:
- Week 0–1: Contracting & MSA exchange (procurement)
- Week 2: Dedicated capacity provisioning + network setup (customer peering/VPC)
- Week 3–4: Test & validation with sample traffic (non-PHI)
- Week 5: Prep cutover for PHI endpoints; security review
- Week 6: PHI cutover to Dedicated; monitor 

Attachments: migration_mode_decision_matrix.xlsx (breakdown of tradeoffs), migration_plan_draft.pdf (detailed steps), sample_msa_redwood.pdf (MSA template link in Drive)

I'll follow up with the SOC2 report and the specific committed pricing PDF once Legal confirms redlines. Please let me know if procurement needs a bundled invoice or a PO-friendly format.

Thanks —
Marissa
